<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="23" x2="315" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="21" x2="320" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="23" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="20" x2="347" y2="26" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="357" y="17" width="25" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="19" width="19" height="8" rx="2" fill="#34EAB9"/>
    <rect x="383" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header accent -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="91" r="18" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <polygon points="34,94 42,82 50,94" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="37" y="93" width="10" height="9" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="91" r="18" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="85" x2="355" y2="85" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="91" x2="355" y2="91" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="97" x2="355" y2="97" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Greeting -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="155" font-family="Poppins" font-size="32px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Hello Again!</text>
    <text x="24" y="187" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Welcome back, you have been missed.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="229" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Username</text>
    <rect x="23" y="239" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="238" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="262" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="45" cy="274" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="67" y="268" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">alex.morgan</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="322" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="332" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="331" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="38" y="351" width="14" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="41,351 41,347 49,347 49,351" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="355" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="359" x2="84" y2="363" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="94" cy="355" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="355" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="114" cy="355" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="124" cy="355" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="355" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="361" x2="354" y2="349" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Support row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="399" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <polyline points="28,409 33,414 41,404" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="53" y="414" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Remember me</text>
    <text x="260" y="414" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Login button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="447" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2"/>
    <rect x="24" y="445" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="476" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Login</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider and continuation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="24" y1="531" x2="157" y2="531" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="233" y1="531" x2="366" y2="531" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="536" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="558" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="556" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="580" r="11" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="52" y="587" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="112" y="586" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Facebook</text>

    <rect x="203" y="558" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="203" y="556" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <circle cx="231" cy="580" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="231" y="586" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" fill="#4285F4">G</text>
    <text x="291" y="586" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="122" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">New to news?</text>
    <text x="265" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Create an account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#25272A"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="42,791 51,783 60,791" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="45" y="790" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="140" cy="791" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="140" y1="791" x2="146" y2="785" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="140" cy="791" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <text x="140" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <polygon points="224,782 238,782 238,801 231,796 224,801" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="231" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="320" cy="787" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="800" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="320" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
